name: W2-E Settings > AI tools on a computer without coding agents
description: Opens an isolated software fixture project, then Settings > Settings… > AI tools (remap slice W2-E, ADR-0054). The CI runner has no Claude Code or Codex, so each row must read 'Not found' with an install link, never a guessed version or sign-in state; Connect, Sign in and Launch session are disabled with the reason as their tooltip; the sessions list says no session was started; the propose-mode note for new sessions is shown.
